thought.text: Login with the documented credentials succeeded (HTTP 201, authenticated session). Now let me verify the authenticated session can actually use the app API, and check asset compilation.

reasoning_content:
Login successful — the documented credentials work:
- POST /api/v1/signin → HTTP 201 (created), session for admin@example.com (Test Admin Agent)
- GET /api/v1/signshow → HTTP 200 with authenticated session

The earlier 401 was due to my incorrect parameter name (email instead of username) — this is a validation error, not a software error.

Now, I'll perform a few more operational checks:
1. Verify that the authenticated session can actually use the app's API (e.g., GET /api/v1/users/me or GET /api/v1/tickets) — proof that the backend works.
2. Verify that the ES index and search work (maybe the ticket search API).
3. Verify that the Vite dev server is serving the frontend assets (302 → where to? probably redirect to /; confirm that assets are being served).
4. Verify that the frontend JS actually loads (application.js via vite?).

Also, I'll re-confirm the version (7.2.0 as claimed) and that the assets compile (vite serving the main JS).

I'll execute these checks.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== Authenticated API calls ==="
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt -o /dev/null -w "GET /api/v1/users/me -> HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/users/me
curl -s -b /tmp/cj3.txt "http://127.0.0.1:3000/api/v1/tickets?limit=3" -o /tmp/tix.json -w "GET /api/v1/tickets -> HTTP %{http_code}\n"
python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open(\"/tmp/tix.json\"));print(\"tickets result_count:\",d.get(\"result_count\"));[print(\" -\",t[\"id\"],t[\"subject\"][:40]) for t in d.get(\"tickets\",[])]" 2>/dev/null || head -c 200 /tmp/tix.json
' 2>&1
